title: Fold scan output
statement: Let $A$ be a state set, let $\Gamma$ be a symbol set, let $\delta:A\to\Gamma\to A$, let $a_0\in A$, and let $w$ be a finite word over $\Gamma$. In a two-pass scan, the first pass reads $w$ from left to right, updates the state by $\delta$, and leaves each symbol unchanged; the second pass reads the resulting word in reverse and also leaves every symbol unchanged. Starting the first pass at $a_0$ and the second at its final state, the overall result is the state obtained by folding $\delta$ from left to right over $w$, together with the unchanged word $w$.
